title: Gas Leak & Hazardous Chemical Spill Guide
summary: Gas leaks present immediate fire, explosion, and asphyxiation risks. Evacuate upwind and eliminate ignition sources.
precautions: If you smell gas or chemical fumes, do NOT operate any electrical switches, appliances, light fixtures, or phones in the area.
Do NOT light matches, lighters, or open flames.
Open doors and windows if safe to do so while evacuating to ventilate the space.
evacuation: Evacuate the building immediately on foot.
Determine wind direction and move UPWIND and CROSSWIND away from the leak source.
Do not start car engines near the suspected gas plume.
Call Emergency Fire & Disaster Response (101 / 108) from a safe location well outside the gas zone.
firstAid: Move exposed persons to fresh air immediately.
If chemical fumes contact eyes or skin, flush with clean running water for at least 15-20 minutes.
If victim is not breathing, administer artificial respiration outside the contaminated area.
emergencyChecklist: Wet cotton cloths or N95 masks to cover nose and mouth
Contact number for local Gas Utility Hotline
dos: DO evacuate upwind away from fumes.
DO cover your mouth and nose with a damp cloth.
donts: DON'T flip light switches or unplug devices.
DON'T use elevators or enclosed stairwells filled with gas.
DON'T smoke or ignite any flame.
